justification: Changes what the single guarded DCP read serves to every surface: precinct-only rules stop being returned council-wide, and every served number is worded from its own unit and from whether the council's sentence actually states a maximum. It also corrects two probes that measured the wrong population and flips three ledger rows, so a wrong edit here either serves a wrong number or turns a gate green on nothing.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: Six mutations were injected one at a time and each turned a named test red, then the files were restored byte-for-byte (101 passed after). 1 precinct skip removed: test_a_precinct_rule_is_not_served_council_wide fails. 2 every number printed in metres: 4 fail incl. test_a_number_prints_in_its_own_unit and the real-wording test. 3 every range printed as minimum and maximum: test_a_range_the_plan_does_not_call_a_maximum_prints_as_a_range fails. 4 the check stops reading the council's sentence for a maximum: test_a_maximum_the_councils_sentence_states_passes fails. 5 the check stops comparing units: test_a_number_printed_in_metres_when_its_unit_is_spaces_fails fails. 6 the check counts no-number notes as numbers: test_a_no_set_number_note_is_not_counted_as_a_number fails.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Printed by a one-off mutation runner kept outside the repo, run against this branch, each line from pytest: 'CAUGHT precinct rules served council-wide again: 1 failed' (FAILED tests/test_conveyancing_db.py::TestSetbackFormatting::test_a_precinct_rule_is_not_served_council_wide); 'CAUGHT every number printed in metres: 4 failed'; 'CAUGHT every range printed as minimum and maximum: 2 failed'; 'CAUGHT check no longer reads the council's sentence for a maximum: 2 failed'; 'CAUGHT check no longer compares units: 1 failed'; 'CAUGHT check counts no-number notes as numbers: 1 failed'; then 'restored: 101 passed in 0.53s'. Against production before the fix, the DQ-99 probe printed 7 scope-limited rows served LGA-wide and the DQ-32c probe printed 4.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: The council's own quoted sentence (source_text) decides whether a maximum is stated, and the row's stored unit decides the unit; neither is inferred from control_type. Live production measured on this branch: the DQ-99 probe asks fetch_dcp_setbacks and returns 0, DQ-39 returns 0, DQ-32c returns 0, the range and unit sub-check passes, and the triple-setback council count is 21.

pre_impl.existing_data: fetch_dcp_setbacks already selected applicability and passed it through untouched; the TS client comments that consumers must not fabricate it. Seven rows carry precinct_specific. The wording helper printed every number as metres and any min/max pair as minimum plus maximum.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The DQ-39 probe was assumed to count served values flagged underivable; its 38 were 20 held-back rows nobody sees plus 18 served rows tagged with the DQ-40 re-file note. The precinct probe restated the guard as SQL, so it could pass on an edited string while the read still served them.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new module. requirement_text replaces inline wording inside conveyancing_db; the probe now calls the existing fetch_dcp_setbacks instead of copying its guard; one new test file covers two existing sub-checks.
pre_impl.external_source_error: If the database is unreachable the probe raises through fetch_dcp_setbacks(raise_on_error=True) and exits non-zero without printing PASSED, so a connection failure cannot read as zero precinct rows served.
pre_impl.frontend_type: The requirement string stays a plain string on the same field; the TS client renders it as before. coverage.ts changes one exported integer and its display string from 22 to 21, both typed as const literals.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Before: an Ashfield buyer saw the Yasmar Estate 4m front setback as the council rule, a Ryde parking rate read '1 m minimum', and a 3-6m lot-width range read as a 6m maximum the plan never sets. After: the precinct rule is absent council-wide and numbers print in their own unit.

functions.name: requirement_text
functions.input: control_type, value_min, value_max, unit and the council's quoted source_text for one served control row.
functions.output: A requirement string in the row's own unit: a range as 'a-b unit' unless the sentence states both minimum and maximum, otherwise 'value unit minimum' or 'value unit maximum' for ceiling controls.
functions.if_none: Unit None defaults to metres as before; value_min None with a value_max prints the maximum; source_text None is treated as empty so a range prints as a plain range, never as a maximum.

functions.name: fetch_dcp_setbacks
functions.input: An open connection and a council slug; reads current, not-held-back dcp_setback_controls rows for that council.
functions.output: Served control entries for every surface, now excluding rows whose applicability is precinct_specific and wording each prescribed number through requirement_text.
functions.if_none: Applicability None is not precinct_specific so the row is still served exactly as before; a council with only precinct rows for a control returns no entry for it rather than a scoped number.

functions.name: no_range_printed_as_a_maximum
functions.input: Served entries from the real serve path for every council, each with value_min, value_max, unit, requirement and source_text.
functions.output: FAIL listing councils where a range reads as a maximum the council's sentence does not state, or a number prints in a unit other than its own; PASS otherwise.
functions.if_none: When the serve path could not be read it returns UNKNOWN with the reason, never PASS; entries with no value are skipped for the unit comparison.

functions.name: every_served_number_is_cited
functions.input: Served entries plus the chapter-to-PDF map; only entries carrying a value_min or value_max are counted as numbers.
functions.output: FAIL with 'N of M numbers' lacking a PDF link or the council's sentence; PASS only when every served number has both.
functions.if_none: A no-number note such as 'No maximum site coverage specified' is not counted; an entry whose source_text is empty still counts as uncited and fails.

values.if_missing: NULL is not precinct_specific, so the row is served as before; only the explicit CHECK-constrained value precinct_specific is skipped.
Blank or NULL unit falls back to metres, the previous behaviour, and the unit sub-check skips rows without a unit.

queries.purpose: DQ-39: count SERVED setback controls carrying a DQ derivability flag, excluding DQ-40 re-file notes
queries.where_clause: is_current AND NOT COALESCE(needs_review, false) AND review_reason IS NOT NULL AND (review_reason LIKE 'DQ %%' OR review_reason LIKE '[DQ-%%') AND review_reason NOT LIKE '[DQ-40 %%'

queries.purpose: Published triple-setback council count, now excluding precinct-only rows the serve path no longer returns
queries.where_clause: is_current AND (needs_review IS NULL OR needs_review=FALSE) AND applicability IS DISTINCT FROM 'precinct_specific' AND lga<>'nsw_statewide' AND lga<>'inner_west'

break_it.scenario: Someone removes the precinct skip from fetch_dcp_setbacks while leaving the probe's SQL untouched.
break_it.what_happens: Precinct rules would be served council-wide again, but the probe asks fetch_dcp_setbacks itself so it goes red.
break_it.how: Probe calls the serve path; unit test test_a_precinct_rule_is_not_served_council_wide caught the mutation; the real-db test asserts the skip and the call are present.
break_it.repro: Replace 'if applicability == "precinct_specific":' with 'if False:' in scripts/conveyancing_db.py and run python -m pytest tests/test_conveyancing_db.py -o addopts=

break_it.scenario: A parking rate row with unit spaces/dwelling is worded by a helper that assumes metres.
break_it.what_happens: Users would read '1 m minimum' for a parking rate; the claim 17 unit sub-check fails and two unit tests fail.
break_it.how: requirement_text formats with the row's own unit; wrong_unit comparison in no_range_printed_as_a_maximum; mutation 2 turned four tests red.
break_it.repro: Change the fmt return to f"{value:g} m" in requirement_text and run python -m pytest tests/test_outreach_claim_checks_ranges_and_citations.py -o addopts=

break_it.scenario: A lot-width range such as rear setback 3m to 6m is printed as '3 m minimum; 6 m maximum'.
break_it.what_happens: A buyer would believe the plan caps the rear setback at 6m when it only varies the minimum by lot width.
break_it.how: Both minimum and maximum are printed only when the council's own sentence states both words; otherwise it prints as a range, and the sub-check reads source_text independently.
break_it.repro: Replace the _STATES_MINIMUM and _STATES_MAXIMUM condition with 'if True:' and run python -m pytest tests/test_conveyancing_db.py -o addopts=

break_it.scenario: The DQ-39 probe is later widened back to all current rows including held-back ones.
break_it.what_happens: It would read 38 again while no served number is flagged, and DQ-39 declared fixed would turn the ledger red.
break_it.how: The ledger enforces declared state both ways, and the probe's comment records the population and the 20 plus 18 breakdown measured on 2026-09-14.
break_it.repro: python scripts/dq_probe_live.py --id DQ-39 after deleting 'AND NOT COALESCE(needs_review, false)' from its SQL, then python scripts/dq_check.py

break_it.scenario: The claim 8 check counts 'No maximum site coverage specified' notes as uncited numbers.
break_it.what_happens: Claim 8 could never pass for notes that have no number to cite, so the gate measures the wrong thing forever.
break_it.how: Entries without value_min and value_max are skipped; test_a_no_set_number_note_is_not_counted_as_a_number caught mutation 6.
break_it.repro: Replace the value_min/value_max None skip with 'if False:' in every_served_number_is_cited and run python -m pytest tests/test_outreach_claim_checks_ranges_and_citations.py -o addopts=

break_it.scenario: The published triple-setback count stays at 22 after Ashfield loses its only front setback row.
break_it.what_happens: The site would overstate coverage by one council and claim OC-2 would contradict its declared true state.
break_it.how: verify_coverage_stats applies the same precinct exclusion and coverage.ts is 21; OC-2 passed on this branch's outreach run.

mutation_analysis: Six mutations run, not described, via a script that edits one target string, runs the two test files, and restores the original bytes: all six caught by the named test (1, 4, 2, 2, 1, 1 failures). Clean run after restoration: 101 passed. Wider suites touching these modules: 446 passed, 19 skipped; granny flat, leichhardt, integration, fidelity gate files: 309 passed, 168 skipped. Full ledger python scripts/dq_check.py exit 0 on this branch.
residual_risk: Precinct rows are now absent rather than shown scoped, so a property inside Haberfield's Yasmar Estate does not see its own 4m rule until a precinct match exists. services/granny_flat.py words its own numbers and was not changed. OC-8 and OC-12 still fail on citations that need their source documents.
